transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hello, doctor. I'm seeking help today because I've been struggling with really extreme mood swings. For the past nine months, I have felt deeply depressed and down, but before that, I went through a period of about five months where I felt abnormally high, energetic, and hyperactive.

During that five-month period when you felt unusually high and energetic, did you have hallucinations or strong beliefs that others said were not true? If so, did any of those experiences ever happen when your mood symptoms were not present?

No, I didn't experience any hallucinations or false beliefs during that time. I never saw or heard things that weren't there, and I didn't hold any beliefs that others found untrue. My mind was just racing, but I stayed grounded in reality.

During that five-month high-energy period, did your symptoms ever become severe enough that you were hospitalized or that they caused major problems at work, school, relationships, or finances? Did you do things that felt very out of character or risky?

Yes, it caused massive financial problems because I went on reckless shopping sprees and made foolish business investments that put my family in deep distress. I also engaged in really risky behaviors and sexual indiscretions that were completely out of character for me.

During these past nine months of feeling depressed, have you had most days with symptoms like low mood or loss of interest along with changes in sleep, appetite, energy, concentration, or feelings of worthlessness?

Yes, absolutely. For the past nine months, I've felt a constant, heavy depression and have completely lost interest in the hobbies I used to love. My sleep has also been a major issue, as I really struggle to fall asleep, wake up frequently during the night, and often wake up way too early in the morning.
